children: JMD Corporate Services Limited disclosed a 14.7% stake in TROOPS, Inc. through a Schedule 13D filing. The company bought 18,000,000 ordinary shares on March 11, 2026, and filed the disclosure on September 18, 2026. The sizable position signals that JMD could engage with TROOPS, Inc. on strategy and governance.

JMD Corporate Services Limited says it acquired the shares for investment and may adjust its plans over time. The firm notes it "may seek to influence management of the Issuer or the Board of Directors with respect to the business and affairs of the Issuer" and could consider the "acquisition by any person of additional securities of the issuer, or the disposition of securities of the issuer." JMD has not announced board nominations or a specific transaction but left the door open to future engagement.

JMD Corporate Services Limited is a Hong Kong–incorporated company with limited liability. The firm provides corporate services in Hong Kong and invests capital on an opportunistic basis. Public details on its prior equity investments are limited, and the filing states no relevant criminal or civil securities judgments in the past five years.
